source_note: 判断剧烈震荡的序列部分和的有界性问题
english_source_note: Boundedness of Partial Sums of Highly Oscillatory Sequences
callout_id: 判断剧烈震荡的序列部分和的有界性问题#3
statement_en: Let $$P(n):=a_dn^d+a_{d-1}n^{d-1}+\cdots+a_1 n +a_0\in \mathbb{R}[n],\ d\geq 2,$$ be a polynomial of degree at least $2$ such that at least one of the coefficients $a_d,\ldots,a_2$ is irrational. Let $F:\mathbb{T}\to \mathbb{C}$ have an absolutely convergent Fourier series and satisfy $$\int_{\mathbb{T}} F=0.$$ Then the sequence $$S_N(F):=\sum_{n=1}^{N}F\circ P(n)$$ is unbounded.
callout_body: 设$$P(n):=a_dn^d+a_{d-1}n^{d-1}+\cdots+a_1 n +a_0\in \mathbb{R}[n],d\geq 2$$是次数至少为2的，系数$a_d,\cdots,a_2$当中至少有一个系数为无理数的多项式。设函数$F:\mathbb{T}\to \mathbb{C}$对应的傅里叶级数绝对收敛，并且积分为0。那么序列$$S_N(F):=\sum_{n=1}^{N}F\circ P(n)$$是一个无界序列。
